## Findings
- Cause located: `BaseExpression.get_group_by_cols` (django/db/models/expressions.py:350) returns `[self]` when `not contains_aggregate`. `ExpressionWrapper` (line 850) does NOT override it, so wrapping `Value(3)` puts the wrapper itself into GROUP BY; `wrapper.as_sql` delegates to `Value.as_sql` → emits literal `3` in GROUP BY. Bare `Value.get_group_by_cols` (line 706) returns `[]`, which is why unwrapped works.
- Fix (matches upstream Django 3.2): add `get_group_by_cols(self, alias=None)` to `ExpressionWrapper` delegating to `self.expression.get_group_by_cols(alias=alias)` (guard `if self.expression`).

## Decisions
- Minimal fix in django/db/models/expressions.py only; no test edits, no commit.
